description: Open/high/low/close price candles and traded volume for a token, newest last, for charts, trend and volatility questions. Prices are per token in ADA (default) or USD; volume is in ADA. Returns compact rows: [time ISO, open, high, low, close, volumeAda, trades].

allPools.description: true aggregates every pool of the token (volume-weighted price, summed volume); false uses its primary pool.

limit.description: How many most recent candles to return (1-500, default 100).

unit.description: Token unit: 56-hex policy id followed by the asset name in hex (no separator). Get it from `search` or `list_tokens`.

name: get_token_candles
title: Token price candles (OHLCV)
